title: Transcriptomic signatures reveal distinct inflammatory pathways and metabolic dysfunction in inflammatory bowel disease

contributions.purpose: 刻画 IBD 与健康对照间的全局转录失调
contributions.evaluation: 炎症 IBD 上皮 vs 对照 3706 个 DEG,fold change -15~+15,-log10(p) 达 80
contributions.source_quote: 3,706 differentially expressed genes identified between inflamed IBD epithelium and healthy controls, demonstrating fold changes spanning -15 to +15 and statistical significance reaching p-values of 10-80

contributions.purpose: 区分 UC 与 CD 分子特征并识别炎症通路
contributions.mechanism: UC vs CD、炎症 vs 非炎症组织差异表达 + GO/KEGG/Reactome 富集
contributions.evaluation: UC/CD 共享 1050 DEG;UC 偏好 IL23A 上调、CD 增强 IFN-γ TH1;IL-17 信号为最显著激活通路(炎症组织 -log10 p 达 12)
contributions.source_quote: UC and CD shared substantial molecular overlap with 1,050 common differentially expressed genes... Pathway enrichment analysis consistently identified IL-17 signaling as the most significantly activated pathway

contributions.purpose: 揭示炎症组织代谢通路的协调抑制
contributions.mechanism: 炎症 vs 非炎症下调通路 GO 富集
contributions.evaluation: 定性:胆汁分泌、肠道胆固醇吸收(GO:0030300)、脂质吸收(GO:1904729)显著下调
contributions.source_quote: inflamed tissues demonstrated coordinated suppression of metabolic pathways, particularly affecting lipid metabolism, cholesterol absorption, and bile secretion

notes: desk-reject。严重数据红旗:(1)方法论自相矛盾——全文声称 bulk RNA-seq,但 QC 段与 Fig.1 图注写的是 "single-cell RNA sequencing data",用 n_genes_by_counts / UMI per cell / pct_counts_mt / 违规"per cell"小提琴图 / doublet cells 等单细胞指标;"20-30 samples per group"混淆样本与细胞。(2)生物学不可能的数字:每"细胞"检出 35000-40000 基因(人类蛋白编码基因仅约 2 万),线粒体基因占比"约 0.00%"极不合理——疑占位/幻数。(3)幻影结果:摘要与结论断言"ML 分类准确率>98%、成功预测多种疗法响应",但 Methods/Results 全无任何 ML 章节、分类器、混淆矩阵或训练细节——该核心卖点无实验支撑。(4)Discussion 大段陈述 S1/S2 分子亚型、20 基因分类器、三-mRNA 面板(IL4R/SLC9A8/EIF5A 84% 准确)、OSM/OSMR 等,均系他引文献结论被当作本文"发现"复述(疑洗稿/文献拼贴)。checklist 缺失(PDF 无 Agents4Science checklist 段)。
